reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (employer-key REST API + a public Atom feed per career page).

endpoints.purpose: public list of a company's open jobs

reference.limits: "We enforce a rate limit of 60 requests per minute" (employer API; `429 You're requesting too much in too little time`). Feed: not published. - Terms of Service (homerun.co/terms-of-service) bind the employer Customer: 11.1 — no access to "non-public areas of our website or Service without authorization", no spam / unsolicited promotion, no attempt to "probe, scan, compromise, test, decompile, reverse engineer … or bypass any part of the SaaS". Nothing addresses candidate-side automation; the Atom feed is a public, linked resource. - Applying is the career-page form (files + custom questions)

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Homerun Public API v2 key generated on https://app.homerun.co/settings/integrations with the `vacancies:read` scope; sent as `Authorization: Bearer`.

me.note: Homerun has no account endpoint; the key is verified with a one-item vacancies list (needs the vacancies:read scope).

search.note: Employer API: GET /v2/vacancies lists the key owner's OWN vacancies (filter[status]=public; include[]=location, department, salaryIndication), not a cross-company search. There is no keyword or location filter, so query/location are not sent — filter client-side. page (default 1) and perPage ('[1 .. 100]', default 15). salary_indication {currency, salary_value, max_salary_value, time_period} is in raw (amounts are decimal strings such as "45000.00"); location_type, type and expires_at too. Rate limit: '60 requests per minute'. Homerun suggests its Job XML Feeds when only listing vacancies.

get_posting.note: GET /v2/vacancies/{vacancy_id} (e.g. job_SnhUsAg1QwTRFIRNUfM6) returns {data: Vacancy}; page_content and salary_indication are in raw.

not_offered.apply: POST /job-applications creates an applicant as the employer (key scope job-applications:write, 'sourced' flag), i.e. the company's own ATS import, not a candidate applying; candidates apply through the Homerun career page.
not_offered.list_messages: The API has no message or conversation endpoints (only notes, tags, answers, files and the confirmation email).

evidence: probe: 3/3 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 3/3 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
